settings.heading: The capsule
settings.sub: Not a weekly drop. Pieces built to stay.

settings.title: 240–480 gsm
settings.text: Heavy jersey and loopback fleece that still holds the shoulder after a twelve-hour service.

settings.title: Garment dye
settings.text: Dyed after the sew. Colour lives in the fibre, not on it. Every piece carries its own shade.

settings.title: Cut for the shift
settings.text: Dropped shoulder, taped collar, a hem that stays put when you bend over the pass.

settings.heading: Father & Son — A Bond That Never Breaks
settings.text: This brand did not start as a business plan. It started as a promise. Twenty years in the kitchen — twelve of them in Norway — so a son could watch what it looks like to build something with your own hands. No shortcuts. No investors.

settings.heading: On the pass, there is no room to lie.
settings.text: The plate either walks or it dies. PJR Built Different is cut from the same tension: cloth, cut, stitch — it holds, or it is out. We do it our way.

settings.heading: Weight you can feel in the hand.
settings.text: Ring-spun cotton. Pre-shrunk. Twin-needle. None of this is marketing — it is the spec a tee dies without by the third wash.
